comment: spell.c learn() 450-455: a book cursed between interrupted study and resumed study. A debug-mode Valkyrie wishes for a blessed spellbook of finger of death, two cursed potions of water and a scroll of genocide, creates a newt so monster_nearby() stops the study after its first turn, genocides newts, dips the book twice in unholy water (blessed -> uncursed -> cursed) and resumes reading. learn() finds the book cursed, cursed_book()'s rn2(7) picks 6 (explosion, returns TRUE), and learn() uses up the book (452-455). Seed chosen by trying fresh seeds 5512331-5512360 for the rn2(7)==6 case.
